name: Frog-shaped dish
label: Dishes
lead: Dish shaped like a stone frog with a round opening on its back - a decorative feeder or water dish that looks like a sculpture in the terrarium.

specs.v: Frog figure, opening on the back

description.html: This dish is shaped like a stocky stone frog with a broad head and legs resting on the ground. On its back there is a round, deep opening for water or food. The grey-beige color and porous surface give it the look of an old stone garden figure.

In the terrarium it plays two roles: it is a dish and a decorative accent that catches the eye. The narrower opening means the contents spill less onto the substrate, so it works well as a feeder for insects, worms or prepared food. As a water dish it better suits animals that can reach the water over the rim than very small hatchlings.
The frog fits nicely into forest and garden-style setups, as well as playfully decorated terrariums. It suits lizards and geckos that eat from a dish.
Change the water or food every day. Since the opening is deep, use a long-handled brush for washing and rinse the dish well. Place it on a level spot so it stands firmly.
